headline: Young Harris end Lees-McRae's unbeaten season
dek: Lees-McRae had won thirteen and drawn three before Young Harris beat them at home, the first defeat of their season. Young Harris stay top of the conference table, and Converse move above Lees-McRae into second.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 49 goals have come from at least fifteen different scorers and have still brought four defeats; spreading the scoring has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: No side in the conference is unbeaten any longer: Young Harris have won at Lees-McRae.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Berry's home match against Shorter.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Francis Marion have won twelve matches, drawn two and lost four, and have conceded twelve goals in all.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Young Harris have won twelve matches, drawn three and lost three, scoring 45 goals and conceding 21.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andre Camargo, a freshman, has scored ten goals and set up five for Chowan, from 32 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Edouard Laberge has made 82 saves for Emmanuel and conceded 22 goals, a save percentage of .788.

last_match.line: It was Lees-McRae's first defeat of the season, and it came against the side that leads the conference table.

next_match.line: Barton have not lost since September; each side has already beaten the other once this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
